_comment: Source of truth for all translatable UI strings. build.rs generates
src/i18n/lang/*.rs from this file; do not edit those by hand.
The 'context' field is the deliverable for translators: it says where the
string appears and what it means. Strings with identical English text but
different meanings must stay separate entries.
Placeholders like {path} must be kept verbatim in every language. Word
order is free to differ per language; a test enforces the placeholders.

strings.context: Column header above the file name column. One word, noun.
Column header above the file size column. One word, noun.
Column header above the modification date. One word; may expand in some languages.
Shown in the size column for directories, like <DIR>. Convention from Norton Commander. Keep the angle brackets; this is deliberately not translated.
Shown in the size column for the parent-directory entry '..', like <UP>. Same convention as the directory marker, also not translated.
Colored field at the left end of the status bar while the left panel is the active one; also its first letter marks the left path tab in the title bar. Upper case, a single short word.
Colored field at the left end of the status bar while the right panel is the active one; also its first letter marks the right path tab in the title bar. Upper case, a single short word.
Status bar text while a directory is being read. The surrounding UI is monospace, so an ellipsis character is fine.
Label of the F9 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key switches the interface language; one short word, at most 8 characters, the slot clips longer text.
Label of the F10 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key quits the app; one short word, at most 8 characters.

Status bar error combining the directory path and the OS error message. Both must appear; word order is up to the language (German leads with the path). Keep the {path} and {reason} placeholders exactly as spelled.

Status bar error when macOS privacy protection refused to read the directory shown at the left of the bar, so no path in the text. The line is cut off at the window edge: keep it short. On macOS the line is a button that opens the Full Disk Access page of System Settings; use the name macOS gives that setting in the language.
strings.en: macOS blocks access. Give ncrs, or the terminal that started it, Full Disk Access (click to open)
strings.de: macOS sperrt den Zugriff. ncrs oder dem Terminal, aus dem es gestartet wurde, Festplattenvollzugriff geben (Klick öffnet)

strings.context: Status bar error shown when the background read task itself failed, not the filesystem. Internal error, users should rarely see it. Keep the {reason} placeholder.
Label of the F1 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key opens the command palette; at most 8 characters.
Label of the F7 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key asks for a new directory name; at most 8 characters, like Norton Commander's MkDir.
Title of the create-directory dialog. Imperative, matches the header hint.
Label next to the text field for the new directory name. One or two words, no colon.
Confirm button in the create-directory dialog. Verb, what the button does.
Button that dismisses any dialog without doing anything. Verb. Used by every dialog, so keep it short.
Verb shown next to the Esc key cap in the footer of every dialog: the key closes or cancels it. Only the verb, the key cap is drawn separately.
Short phrase shown next to the Tab key cap in the footer of a dialog with more than one button or field: the key moves the focus. Only the phrase, the key cap is drawn separately.
Short word shown next to the Left and Right arrow key caps in the footer of a Hermes page: the keys move the focus between the sidebar and the page. Only the word, the key cap is drawn separately.
Shown in the dialog when the name field is empty. Addressed to the user, not a technical error.
Shown when the user typed . or .., which cannot be a directory name. Mention that this is not allowed rather than what it would navigate to.
Shown when the typed name contains a path separator. The new directory is always created inside the current one, so tell the user to use a plain name.
strings.de: Ein Name darf kein / oder \ enthalten

strings.context: Shown when creating the directory failed for a reason the user could not have predicted — a permission problem, a read-only disk, a full filesystem. Takes the directory name and the OS reason. For the two predictable failures use error.mkdir_taken and error.parent_missing instead.
Shown when a directory with the name the user typed already exists. Takes the name. Do not suggest a different name — just say it is taken.
Shown when the panel's own directory no longer exists: it was deleted, renamed or unmounted while the dialog was open. Tells the user the panel is out of date, not that they typed something wrong.
Status bar while files are being copied. Present continuous. Keep it short — the bar is one line.
Status bar while files are being moved. Same shape as job.copy, so both fit the bar.
Status bar while files are being deleted. Same shape as job.copy.
Status bar while the documents are being moved according to the reorganisation plan. Same shape as job.copy.
Status bar while inbox documents are being filed into the archive by the rules. Same shape as job.copy.
Status bar while a directory is being created. Same shape as job.copy.
Progress counter in the status bar while a job runs. Shows done and total. Keep the punctuation minimal; the numbers are what matter.
Shown in the status bar when jobs are waiting behind the running one. Takes the count.
Status bar confirmation after the user copied the full path of one file or folder to the clipboard. Past participle, short.
Status bar confirmation after the user copied the full paths of several files or folders to the clipboard. Takes the count, which is always two or more.
Status bar confirmation after the user copied the name (without the folder) of one file or folder to the clipboard. Past participle, short.
Status bar confirmation after the user copied the names (without the folder) of several files or folders to the clipboard. Takes the count, which is always two or more.
Entry of the context menu on a file or folder: enters the folder under the cursor. Shown with its key (Enter) on the right. Verb, imperative.
Entry of the context menu: opens the file under the cursor in an external viewer (key F3). Verb, imperative; the function key bar has a shorter label.
Entry of the context menu: opens the file under the cursor in an external editor (key F4). Verb, imperative; the function key bar has a shorter label.
Entry of the context menu: copies the tagged rows, or the cursor row, into the other panel (key F5). Verb, imperative.
Entry of the context menu: moves the tagged rows, or the cursor row, into the other panel (key F6). Verb, imperative.
Entry of the context menu: asks for a name and creates a folder in the current directory (key F7). Noun phrase.
Entry of the context menu: puts the full path of the tagged rows, or the cursor row, on the clipboard. Verb, imperative.
Entry of the context menu: puts the name (without the folder) of the tagged rows, or the cursor row, on the clipboard. Verb, imperative.

Entry of the context menu: moves the tagged rows, or the cursor row, to the trash after a confirmation (key F8). The German text is a prepositional phrase because the entry reads as an action on the selection.
Entry of the context menu: deletes the tagged rows, or the cursor row, for good, bypassing the trash, after a confirmation (key Shift+F8). Verb phrase, imperative.
Tooltip of the small copy icon at the right end of the path field in the status bar. The icon copies the path of the directory shown in the active panel to the clipboard. Verb, imperative.
Status bar error after the user typed a path into the path field and pressed Enter, but nothing exists there. {path} is the path as typed, after expanding a leading ~. Keep the placeholder verbatim.

Status bar error after the user typed a path into the path field and pressed Enter, but the system would not say whether it exists (no permission, a mount that does not answer). {path} is the path as typed, after expanding a leading ~. {reason} is the system's own message, in the system's language. Keep both placeholders verbatim.
Key hint for stopping the running job. Verb, matches the other hints in the header row.
Label of the F5 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key copies into the other panel; imperative verb, at most 8 characters.
Label of the F6 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key moves into the other panel; imperative verb, at most 8 characters.
Label of the F3 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key opens the file under the cursor in an external viewer; imperative verb, at most 8 characters.
Label of the F4 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key opens the file under the cursor in an external editor; imperative verb, at most 8 characters.
Title of the dialog asking what to do about a file that already exists at the target. A playful name, noun phrase, no punctuation; conflict.subtitle below it says plainly what is wrong.
Line below the title of the dialog asking what to do about a file that already exists at the target. States the problem plainly; no punctuation.
The name that is taken, shown as the subject of the conflict dialog. Just the name, no quotes needed — the dialog frames it.
Button: replace the existing file with the one being copied or moved. Verb.
Button: leave the existing file alone and skip this one. Verb. NOT the same as Cancel — Cancel stops the whole operation, this skips one file.
Checkbox or suffix meaning this answer applies to every remaining file, not just this one. Short. Translate as a checkbox label, so an infinitive or a short noun both work.
Button: stop the whole operation, not just this file. Verb. Must be clearly distinct from conflict.keep, which skips one file and continues.
Label of the F8 slot in the function key bar at the bottom of the window. The key deletes into the trash; imperative verb, at most 8 characters.
Title of the confirmation dialog for F8, which moves entries to the trash. Imperative.
Playful line below the title of the confirmation dialog for F8, which moves entries to the trash. Not shown for permanent deletion.
Title of the confirmation dialog for Shift+F8, which deletes without any way back. Must sound final and clearly different from delete.title_trash.
Subject line of the delete dialog when exactly one entry is affected. Takes the entry name; the dialog frames it, so no quotes.
Subject line of the delete dialog when several entries are affected. Takes the count, which is always two or more.
Last line of the permanent-delete dialog when more than five entries are affected: how many were not listed. Takes the count, at least one.
Warning in the permanent-delete dialog. Says plainly that the entries do not go to the trash and cannot be restored. One or two short sentences.
strings.en: This cannot be undone. Nothing goes to the trash.
strings.de: Das lässt sich nicht rückgängig machen. Nichts landet im Papierkorb.

strings.context: Default button of the trash dialog: move the entries to the trash. Verb phrase.
Button of the permanent-delete dialog that really deletes. Verb phrase; not the default button there.

Status bar when the trash could not take an entry (no trash on this volume, a network drive, no permission). Takes the name, the reason and {key}, the key that deletes without the trash, spelled as the app spells keys (e.g. Shift+F8); keep {key} as is. Must tell the user that this key deletes permanently.
strings.en: Could not move {name} to the trash: {reason}. {key} deletes permanently.
strings.de: {name} konnte nicht in den Papierkorb: {reason}. {key} löscht endgültig.

strings.context: Like error.trash_failed, for when the user has no key for deleting permanently: no hint about a key. Takes the name and the reason.
strings.en: Could not move {name} to the trash: {reason}.

strings.context: Title of the drive menu opened with Alt+F1 or Alt+F2, above the line that says which panel it is for. A playful name for the places a panel can show (disks, mounted volumes, the home folder); a noun, no punctuation.

Line below the title of the drive menu opened with Alt+F1, which picks the place the left panel shows. Imperative; the word 'drive' stands for a disk, a mounted volume or another place such as the home folder. The title above it is volumes.title.
Line below the title of the drive menu opened with Alt+F2, which picks the place the right panel shows. Imperative; same meaning of 'drive' as in volumes.subtitle_left.
Status bar when deleting an entry permanently failed. Takes the name and the OS reason.
Status bar when the external program for F3 or F4 could not be started. Takes the file name and the OS reason.
Name of the macOS System Settings app, filled into the {name} of error.open_failed when its Full Disk Access page could not be opened. Use the name macOS gives the app in the language.

Status bar when the view or edit key refuses a file because opening it with the system could run it (script, app, shortcut). Takes the file name and {keys}, the view and edit keys joined with a slash, spelled as the app spells keys (e.g. F3/F4); keep {keys} as is.
strings.en: {name} could be executed, so {keys} will not open it
strings.de: {name} könnte ausgeführt werden und wird mit {keys} nicht geöffnet

strings.context: Like error.open_refused, for when the user has no key for viewing or editing: no key names. Takes the file name.
strings.en: {name} could be executed, ncrs does not open it
strings.de: {name} könnte ausgeführt werden, ncrs öffnet es nicht

strings.context: Status bar at startup when the config file could not be read: it has an error at a known line. Takes the file path, the line number and the reason. The reason is the English message of the TOML parser and stays untranslated. The app runs on with the default settings.
strings.en: Config file {path}, line {line}: {reason}. Using the defaults.
strings.de: Konfigurationsdatei {path}, Zeile {line}: {reason}. Es gelten die Standardwerte.

strings.context: Status bar at startup when the config file could not be used and no line applies: the file is unreadable, not a regular file, too big, or the error has no position. Takes the file path and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated. The app runs on with the default settings.

Status bar at startup when the colors in the config file are valid and in use, but a text color is hard to read on its background. Takes the file path, the line number, the names of the two color roles (they are the config keys and stay untranslated) and the contrast ratio, a number with one decimal place.
strings.en: Config file {path}, line {line}: {foreground} on {background} has a contrast of only {ratio}:1 and may be hard to read.
strings.de: Konfigurationsdatei {path}, Zeile {line}: {foreground} auf {background} hat nur ein Kontrastverhältnis von {ratio}:1 und ist womöglich schwer lesbar.

strings.context: Same as the contrast warning with a line, for when no line applies: the colors come from the built-in palette only. Takes the file path, the names of the two color roles (config keys, untranslated) and the contrast ratio with one decimal place.
strings.en: Config file {path}: {foreground} on {background} has a contrast of only {ratio}:1 and may be hard to read.
strings.de: Konfigurationsdatei {path}: {foreground} auf {background} hat nur ein Kontrastverhältnis von {ratio}:1 und ist womöglich schwer lesbar.

strings.context: Status bar at startup when the VS Code theme file named by `vscode` in the config's [theme] section could not be used, or not in full. The config itself is valid and in use, with the preset colors and the color keys. Takes the config file path, the line of the `vscode` entry, the path of the theme file and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: Config file {path}, line {line}: VS Code theme {theme}: {reason}. Where it gives no colors, the preset applies.
strings.de: Konfigurationsdatei {path}, Zeile {line}: VS-Code-Theme {theme}: {reason}. Wo es keine Farben liefert, gilt das Preset.

strings.context: Same as the VS Code theme warning with a line, for when no line can be named. Takes the config file path, the path of the theme file and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: Config file {path}: VS Code theme {theme}: {reason}. Where it gives no colors, the preset applies.
strings.de: Konfigurationsdatei {path}: VS-Code-Theme {theme}: {reason}. Wo es keine Farben liefert, gilt das Preset.

strings.context: Title bar of the search view that replaces a file panel, a single line: a playful name, a colon, then what it does. Takes {path}, the directory the search runs in.
Placeholder of the search text field at the top of the search view, shown while it is empty. A short verb or noun.
Label in front of the field that limits the search to file names matching patterns (the include field). Ends with a colon, kept short: the label column is narrow.
Label in front of the field that lists patterns of files and directories to leave out of the search. Ends with a colon, kept short: the label column is narrow.
Placeholder of the Files field in the search view: an example of patterns separated by semicolons. Patterns are globs, a trailing slash means a directory.
Placeholder of the Exclude field in the search view: an example of patterns separated by semicolons. Patterns are globs, a trailing slash means a directory with everything in it.
Tooltip of the Aa toggle button next to the search field. Turning it on makes upper and lower case letters different.
Tooltip of the ab toggle button next to the search field. Turning it on finds the text only as a whole word.
Tooltip of the .* toggle button next to the search field. Turning it on reads the text as a regular expression.
Summary line of a search in file contents, under the search fields. Takes the number of files with a match and the number of matching lines.
Summary line of a search by file name only (the search field is empty), under the search fields. Takes the number of files found.
Appended to the summary line of the search view when some files could not be searched (unreadable, too big, binary or offline). Starts with a separator and a space; takes the count.
Appended to the summary line of the search view when the search stopped because it reached the maximum number of matches. Starts with a separator and a space.
Summary line of the search view while the search is still running. Takes the number of files looked at so far.
Summary line of the search view when a finished search found nothing.
Summary line of the search view while both the search field and the Files field are empty: tells what typing does.
strings.en: Type to search file contents, or fill in Files for a name search
strings.de: Tippen sucht in Dateiinhalten, nur „Dateien“ ausgefüllt sucht nach Namen

strings.context: Summary line of the search view in red when a pattern of the Files or Exclude field is not valid. Takes the pattern and the reason, which is English text of the glob parser and stays untranslated.
Summary line of the search view in red when the text is not a valid regular expression. Takes the reason, which is English text of the regex parser and stays untranslated.
Title of the Quick Open box (Ctrl+P / Cmd+P) in which a file name is typed to jump to the file. A playful name, not a description; the plain description is quickopen.subtitle below it.
Line below the title of the Quick Open box (Ctrl+P / Cmd+P), saying plainly what the box does. Takes {dir}, the name of the directory the files are listed from.
Placeholder of the text field of the Quick Open box, shown while it is empty. A short instruction.
strings.en: Type part of a file name

strings.context: Status line of the Quick Open box while the directory tree is still being read. Takes the number of files found so far.
Status line of the Quick Open box once the whole directory tree is read. Takes the number of files.
Status line of the Quick Open box when the tree has more files than are listed. Takes the number of files that were listed.
Status line of the Quick Open box when nothing that was typed matches a file name.
Placeholder of the text field of the command palette, shown while it is empty. A short instruction.
strings.en: Type part of an action name

strings.context: Status line of the command palette when nothing that was typed matches an action name.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Theme name of the command group group.hermes, shown dimmed after its plain name in the command palette. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the group holds.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
Heading of a group of commands in the command palette (and, later, a menu of the same name). One or two words.
The first entry of the app menu on a Mac: shows the version and licenses of the app.
Entry of the app menu on a Mac that opens the system's list of services other apps offer.
Entry of the app menu on a Mac that hides the app's windows until the app is picked again.
Entry of the app menu on a Mac that hides the windows of all other apps.
Entry of the app menu on a Mac that shows the windows of all apps again.
Entry of the Window menu on a Mac that puts the window into the Dock.
Entry of the Window menu on a Mac that toggles the window between its size and the largest useful size.
Entry of the Window menu on a Mac that makes the window fill the screen.
Entry of the Window menu on a Mac that puts every window of the app in front of other apps.
Title of the app menu on a Mac, the first menu of the menu bar. The system shows the app's own name there instead.
Heading above the commands that were run last, at the top of the command palette while the field is empty.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action quit. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action go_up. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action open. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action switch_language. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action toggle_tag. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action toggle_tag, shown dimmed after its plain name action.toggle_tag in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action tag_all. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action tag_all, shown dimmed after its plain name action.tag_all in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action clear_tags. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action clear_tags, shown dimmed after its plain name action.clear_tags in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action abort_job. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action copy_path. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action copy_name. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action view. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action edit. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action copy. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action delete. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action delete_permanently. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action mkdir. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action sort_by_name. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action sort_by_modified. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action search. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action search, shown dimmed after its plain name action.search in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action quick_open. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action quick_open, shown dimmed after its plain name action.quick_open in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action filing_status. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action filing_status, shown dimmed after its plain name action.filing_status in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action filing_setup. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action search_regex. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.
Entry of the command palette that runs the key action command_palette. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action command_palette, shown dimmed after its plain name action.command_palette in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Title of the card that asks whether the document index is encrypted. Shown once, when the index does not exist yet.
Radio option in the index card: the index database is encrypted with a key held by the operating system. Marked as the recommended choice.
Radio option in the index card: the index database is stored without encryption.
First explanation paragraph in the index card: encryption of the index does not affect the filed PDF files themselves.
strings.en: The filed PDFs stay unencrypted in their folders.
strings.de: Die abgelegten PDFs bleiben unverschlüsselt in ihren Ordnern.

strings.context: Second explanation paragraph in the index card: the index contains the full text of every document, which matters when the file is backed up or synced.
strings.en: The index holds the full text of all documents in a single file. Keep that in mind for backups and cloud sync.
strings.de: Der Index enthält den Volltext aller Dokumente in einer einzigen Datei. Das ist bei Backups und Cloud-Synchronisierung wichtig.

strings.context: Third explanation paragraph in the index card: a warning about folders on encrypted drives such as a mounted Cryptomator vault when the index is not encrypted.
strings.en: With an unencrypted index, do not add folders from an encrypted drive (for example a mounted Cryptomator vault): their text would end up in the index in plain form. ncrs does not detect such drives.
strings.de: Bei einem unverschlüsselten Index keine Ordner von einem verschlüsselten Laufwerk hinzufügen (zum Beispiel einen eingebundenen Cryptomator-Tresor): Deren Text landet sonst unverschlüsselt im Index. ncrs erkennt solche Laufwerke nicht.

strings.context: Button in the index card that creates the index with the chosen option. Verb phrase.
Button in the filing cards that closes the card without doing anything. Filing stays off for this session.
Error line in the index card when the index could not be created. Takes the technical reason.
strings.en: The index could not be created: {reason}
strings.de: Der Index konnte nicht angelegt werden: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the card that shows the master key of a new encrypted index. The key is also what other texts call the recovery key.
Explanation in the recovery key card: the key is shown only once and must be stored safely.
strings.en: This key is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe: you need it if the system keystore ever loses the index key.
strings.de: Dieser Schlüssel wird nur einmal angezeigt. Bitte sicher aufbewahren: Er wird gebraucht, falls der Schlüsselbund des Systems den Indexschlüssel verliert.

strings.context: Button in the recovery key card that copies the key to the clipboard. One word, verb.
Short confirmation in the title bar after the master key was copied to the clipboard. Must not contain the key.

Hint above the field in the master key card. One block of four characters of the key is highlighted in the key above, and the user types it to show that the key was saved. Takes the block number, counted from 1.
strings.en: Type block {group} (the highlighted four characters) to show that you saved the key.
strings.de: Tippe Block {group} (die hervorgehobenen vier Zeichen) ab, damit klar ist, dass du den Schlüssel gespeichert hast.

strings.context: Button in the recovery key card that confirms the typed group and goes on.
Error line in the master key card when the typed block is not the requested one. Takes the block number, counted from 1.
strings.en: That is not block {group} of the key.
strings.de: Das ist nicht Block {group} des Schlüssels.

strings.context: Title of the card that asks for the recovery key because the index cannot be opened with the system keystore.
Explanation in the restore card: the system keystore holds no key for the existing encrypted index.
strings.en: The key for the index is not in the system keystore. Enter the recovery key to open the index.
strings.de: Der Schlüssel für den Index ist nicht im Schlüsselbund des Systems. Zum Öffnen des Index den Wiederherstellungsschlüssel eingeben.

strings.context: Explanation in the restore card: the system keystore holds a key that does not open the existing encrypted index.
strings.en: A key is stored, but it does not open this index. The stored key is replaced only if the recovery key you enter opens the index.
strings.de: Es ist ein Schlüssel gespeichert, er öffnet diesen Index aber nicht. Der gespeicherte Schlüssel wird nur ersetzt, wenn der eingegebene Wiederherstellungsschlüssel den Index öffnet.

strings.context: Checkbox label in the restore card: the user agrees that the key in the system keystore is replaced.
Placeholder of the text field in the restore card where the recovery key is typed.
Button in the restore card that puts the typed recovery key into the empty system keystore. Verb.
Button in the restore card that replaces the stored key by the typed recovery key. Verb phrase.
Error line in the restore card when the typed text is not a recovery key.
strings.en: That is not a valid recovery key (52 letters and digits, in groups of four).
strings.de: Das ist kein gültiger Wiederherstellungsschlüssel (52 Buchstaben und Ziffern in Vierergruppen).

strings.context: Error line in the restore card when the typed recovery key does not open the index.
strings.en: This recovery key does not open the index.
strings.de: Dieser Wiederherstellungsschlüssel öffnet den Index nicht.

strings.context: Error line in the restore card when the user submits before ticking the checkbox that allows replacing the stored key.
strings.de: Zuerst den Haken bei "Gespeicherten Schlüssel ersetzen" setzen.

strings.context: Error line in the restore card when applying the recovery key failed for another reason. Takes the technical reason.
strings.en: The key could not be applied: {reason}
strings.de: Der Schlüssel konnte nicht übernommen werden: {reason}

strings.context: Title of the warning card shown when the index file is not encrypted although a key is stored for it.
Warning in the plain file card: the file may have been swapped for an unencrypted one; nothing is taken in until the user confirms.
strings.en: The index file is not encrypted, although a key is stored for it. It may have been replaced by an unencrypted file. Nothing is taken in until you confirm.
strings.de: Die Indexdatei ist nicht verschlüsselt, obwohl dafür ein Schlüssel gespeichert ist. Sie wurde möglicherweise durch eine unverschlüsselte Datei ersetzt. Bis zur Bestätigung wird nichts aufgenommen.

strings.context: Button in the plain file card that accepts the unencrypted index file for this session.
Title of the card shown when the index could not be opened at all.
Line in the failure card. Takes the technical reason.
strings.en: The index could not be opened: {reason}
strings.de: Der Index konnte nicht geöffnet werden: {reason}

strings.context: Reason in the failure card when the operating system gives no place to keep the index.
strings.en: No data directory could be determined.
strings.de: Es konnte kein Datenverzeichnis ermittelt werden.

strings.context: Button in the failure card that closes it. One word, verb.
Notice in the title bar after the filing module (Hermes) started: some configured folders cannot be used. Takes the number of folders.
strings.en: {count} Hermes folders skipped: not reachable or overlapping
strings.de: {count} Hermes-Ordner übersprungen: nicht erreichbar oder überlappend

strings.context: Progress of the filing module at the right end of the status bar while files are in the pipeline; pressing it opens the Inspection (filing status page). Takes the number of files done and the number of files in this stretch of work.
Like the filing progress in the status bar, shown while the pipeline is paused with files left.
Chip in the title bar while the filing module (Hermes) is working: files per minute, measured over the last full minutes. Takes the number. Pressing it opens the Inspection.
Chip in the title bar while the filing module (Hermes) is paused; pressing it opens the Inspection.
Heading of the section with the state, the load and the steps of the filing pipeline.
Heading of the section that lists what each worker thread of the pipeline is doing right now.
Heading of the section with figures about the document index.
Heading of the list of the latest errors of the pipeline.
Label in front of the state of the pipeline on the filing status page.
State of the pipeline: it is working on files.
State of the pipeline: the user paused it; running files still finish their steps.
State of the pipeline: it runs but has nothing to do.
State of the pipeline: it is not running, for example because the index is not open.
Button on the filing status page that pauses the pipeline. Verb.
Button on the filing status page that continues a paused pipeline. Verb.
Label in front of the three load buttons on the filing status page. The load says how many workers the pipeline may use.
Button for the lowest load of the pipeline: few workers, so the computer stays usable (config value gentle). Themed name; the explanation line names the plain meaning.
Button for the middle load of the pipeline (config value balanced). Themed name; the explanation line names the plain meaning.
Button for the highest load of the pipeline: one worker per processor core (config value full). Themed name; the explanation line names the plain meaning.
Label in front of the buttons that raise or lower the number of workers by one, followed by the current number.
Note under the load buttons: a change made on the page is not written to the configuration file.
strings.en: A change applies until ncrs is restarted; config.toml is not changed.
strings.de: Eine Änderung gilt bis zum Neustart von ncrs; config.toml wird nicht geändert.

strings.context: Note next to the load buttons on the filing status page: the plain meaning of the three themed names, in the order of the buttons.
strings.en: By the book = gentle, Business as usual = balanced, Grade 36 = full load.
strings.de: Dienst nach Vorschrift = schonend, Normalbetrieb = ausgewogen, Grad 36 = volle Last.

strings.context: Visible name of the pipeline step that takes documents into the index, in the step lines, the worker lines and the error list of the inspection page. Themed name.
Visible name of the pipeline step that decides which documents need the user's review. Themed name, the same word as the Pending label.
Dimmed, instead of a throughput or time-left figure, while documents are waiting but no full minute of work has been measured yet.
Heading of the section with the throughput and time-left figures; must differ from the Throughput figure label below it.
Label in front of the number of documents the pipeline filed per minute.
Documents per minute. Takes the number.
Label in front of the estimated time until the files in the pipeline are done.
Estimated time left. Takes the number of minutes.
Shown for a worker that has no job right now. Lower case.
What a worker does: it starts the other worker threads. Lower case, short.
What a worker does: it sets up the watching of the filing folders. Lower case, short.
What a worker does: it looks through a filing folder for files. Lower case, short.
Label for the path of the index file on the filing status page.
Label for the size of the index file on disk.
Label for whether the index file is encrypted.
Answer on the filing status page. Lower case.
Answer on the filing status page. Lower case.
Label for the version of the index database schema.
Label for the number of documents in the index.
Label for the disk space used by the full text search part of the index.
Label for the number of documents waiting for the user's review. Pending is the themed name; the explanation follows the number in its own text.
Shown instead of the index figures when they could not be read. Takes the reason.
Shown instead of the index figures while the index is not open.
Shown in the error list of the filing status page when there are no errors.
Heading of the table on the filing status page that lists, per pipeline step, how many documents wait, are done, failed or stay unchanged.
Column title in the table of pipeline steps on the filing status page: documents waiting for this step.
Column title in the table of pipeline steps on the filing status page: documents this step has finished.
Column title in the table of pipeline steps on the filing status page: documents on which this step failed.
Column title in the table of pipeline steps on the filing status page: documents this step found unchanged and skipped.
Verb next to the P key cap in the footer of the filing status page: the key pauses or resumes the pipeline. Only the verb, the key cap is drawn separately.
Word next to the 1 2 3 key caps in the footer of the filing status page: the keys choose the load. Only the word, the key caps are drawn separately.
Word next to the + - key caps in the footer of the filing status page: the keys change the number of workers. Only the word, the key caps are drawn separately.
Word next to the up and down arrow key caps in the footer of the filing status page: the keys move through the list of errors, Enter opens one. Only the word, the key caps are drawn separately.
Label of a figure under a run of a saved query when exactly one of the found documents is missing on disk; the figure itself is the number 1.
Label of a figure under a run of a saved query when none or several of the found documents are missing on disk; the figure itself is the number.
Title of the filing setup, a card above the panels where the user picks the folders Hermes (the name of the filing module) works with.
Explanation at the top of the filing setup card. Hermes is the name of the filing module; the two sections below ask for the Tubes folders and the document folders.
strings.en: Hermes files your documents. Choose the folders it works with.
strings.de: Hermes legt deine Dokumente ab. Wähle die Ordner, mit denen er arbeitet.

strings.context: Heading of the first section of the filing setup card, which lists the inbox folders (config mode "inbox"). Tubes is the themed name for inboxes; the question says what they are.
strings.en: Tubes: where do new documents arrive?
strings.de: Rohrpost: Wo kommen neue Dokumente an?

strings.context: Explanation under the heading of the Tubes section in the filing setup card: documents are picked up from these folders and filed, which empties them.
strings.en: Hermes picks them up there and files them. These folders are emptied.
strings.de: Hermes holt sie dort ab und legt sie ab. Diese Ordner werden geleert.

strings.context: Muted line in the Tubes section of the filing setup card: says that the section is optional and gives examples of folders to add.
strings.en: Optional, e.g. Downloads or a scanner folder
strings.de: Optional, z. B. Downloads oder ein Scanner-Ordner

strings.context: Heading of the second section of the filing setup card, which lists the document folders (config mode "archive").
strings.en: Where do you keep your documents?
strings.de: Wo bewahrst du deine Dokumente auf?

strings.context: Explanation under the heading of the documents section in the filing setup card. Central Filing is the themed name for the document folder that new documents are moved into (config key target).
strings.en: Hermes reads them and learns how you file. Documents are only moved into the Central Filing.
strings.de: Hermes liest sie und lernt, wie du ablegst. Dokumente werden nur in die Zentralregistratur verschoben.

strings.context: Muted line in the documents section of the filing setup card: explains the two kinds of document folder. Central Filing and Records are the themed names; use the same words as the labels in the list.
strings.en: Central Filing: new documents are filed here. Records: only read, nothing is moved.
strings.de: Zentralregistratur: Hier werden neue Dokumente abgelegt. Aktenkeller: wird nur gelesen, nichts wird verschoben.

strings.context: Label in a row of the documents section of the filing setup card: this document folder is the one new documents are filed into (archive with target = true).
Label in a row of the documents section of the filing setup card: this document folder is only read, nothing is moved into it (archive without target).
Button in the filing setup card, once per section: opens the system dialog to pick a folder to add to that section. Ends with an ellipsis because a dialog follows.
Button in the filing setup card, once per section, next to the add folder button: adds the folder shown in the active panel instead of opening a dialog. A muted line with that folder follows it.
strings.en: Use the folder in the panel

strings.context: Shown in a section of the filing setup card while no folder has been added to it.
Checkbox next to a folder in the filing setup card: whether images in it are read too.
Button next to a location in the filing setup card: takes it off the list.
Note in the filing setup card when the chosen folder is already in the list; nothing is added and this is not an error. Takes the folder path.
Rule message in the filing setup card: the written list has document folders, but none is the target. Normally the card prevents this; it can come from a failed write.
strings.en: One folder must be the Central Filing.
strings.de: Ein Ordner muss die Zentralregistratur sein.

strings.context: Rule message in the filing setup card: more than one folder is the target. Normally the card prevents this; it can come from a failed write.
strings.en: Only one folder can be the Central Filing.
strings.de: Nur ein Ordner kann die Zentralregistratur sein.

strings.context: Rule message in the filing setup card: a Tubes folder is marked as the target. Normally the card prevents this; it can come from a failed write.
strings.en: A Tubes folder cannot be the Central Filing.
strings.de: Ein Rohrpost-Ordner kann nicht die Zentralregistratur sein.

strings.context: Rule message in the filing setup card: two folders are the same or one lies inside the other. Takes both paths. Saving waits until it is fixed.
strings.en: {first} and {second} overlap: a folder cannot lie inside another one.
strings.de: {first} und {second} überschneiden sich: Ein Ordner darf nicht in einem anderen liegen.

strings.context: Problem line in the filing setup card while the list has no document folder; saving waits until one is added. A Tubes folder alone is not enough.
strings.en: Add at least one folder where you keep your documents.
strings.de: Füge mindestens einen Ordner hinzu, in dem du deine Dokumente aufbewahrst.

strings.context: Problem line in the filing setup card while there are two or more document folders and none is chosen as the Central Filing; saving waits until the user picks one with the radio buttons.
strings.en: Choose which folder is the Central Filing.
strings.de: Wähle, welcher Ordner die Zentralregistratur ist.

strings.context: Error in the filing setup card when the chosen folder cannot be added. Takes the path and the reason from the operating system, which stays untranslated.
Error in the filing setup card when the system names no place for the config file, so the folders cannot be saved.
strings.en: The system names no place for the config file, so the folders cannot be saved.
strings.de: Das System nennt keinen Ort für die Konfigurationsdatei, daher können die Ordner nicht gespeichert werden.

strings.context: Error in the filing setup card when a folder name cannot be written to the config file. Takes the path.
strings.en: {path} cannot be written to the config file: its name is not valid UTF-8.
strings.de: {path} kann nicht in die Konfigurationsdatei geschrieben werden: Der Name ist kein gültiges UTF-8.

strings.context: Error in the filing setup card when the config file has an error at a known line: nothing was written. Takes the file path, the line number and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: Not saved, the config file {path} has an error in line {line}: {reason}
strings.de: Nicht gespeichert, die Konfigurationsdatei {path} hat einen Fehler in Zeile {line}: {reason}

strings.context: Error in the filing setup card when the config file cannot be read or has an error without a line: nothing was written. Takes the file path and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
strings.en: Not saved, the config file {path} cannot be used: {reason}
strings.de: Nicht gespeichert, die Konfigurationsdatei {path} ist nicht verwendbar: {reason}

strings.context: Error in the filing setup card when writing the config file failed. Takes the path and the reason from the operating system, which stays untranslated.
Notice in the title bar after saving the filing setup when Hermes starts with the saved folders right away. Takes the key that opens the Inspection (the filing status page), spelled for the platform.
strings.en: Hermes is on. Open the Inspection with {key}.
strings.de: Hermes ist eingeschaltet. Die Inspektion öffnest du mit {key}.

strings.context: Notice in the title bar after saving the filing setup when Hermes starts right away but no key is bound to the Inspection (the filing status page). Palette means the command palette of the app.
strings.en: Hermes is on. Open the Inspection from the command palette.
strings.de: Hermes ist eingeschaltet. Die Inspektion öffnest du über „Aktion ausführen“.

strings.context: Notice in the title bar after saving the filing setup while Hermes already runs on configured folders: the new folders apply from the next start of ncrs.
strings.en: Saved. Hermes uses the new folders from the next start of ncrs.
strings.de: Gespeichert. Hermes nimmt die neuen Ordner ab dem nächsten Start von ncrs.

strings.context: Button in the filing setup card: closes it without saving.
Button in the filing setup card: writes the locations to the config file.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action fetch_theme, which downloads a VS Code color theme from Open VSX. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a card with a question follows.
Title of the card that downloads a VS Code color theme from Open VSX, opened from the command palette.
Placeholder of the text field in the theme download card, shown while it is empty. The extension ID has the form publisher.name; a link to the extension is accepted too.

Help line under the text field in the theme download card. Open VSX is the open extension registry; the name stays as it is. Its downloads may come from a second Open VSX host, so the line names the registry, not a single host.
strings.en: Downloads only from Open VSX. Nothing goes out before you press Enter or Fetch.
strings.de: Lädt nur von Open VSX. Es geht nichts raus, bevor du Enter oder Holen drückst.

strings.context: Button in the theme download card: starts the download of the typed extension.
Button in the theme download card: closes it without installing anything.
Status line in the theme download card while the extension is downloaded from Open VSX.
Status line in the theme download card while the theme files are written and the config is changed.
Line above the list of themes in the theme download card, shown when the downloaded extension contains several color themes and the user picks one.
strings.en: This extension has several color themes. Pick one with Up/Down and Enter.
strings.de: Diese Erweiterung hat mehrere Farbschemata. Wähle eins mit Auf/Ab und Enter.

strings.context: Line in the theme download card naming the downloaded extension. Takes its display name and its version.
Line in the theme download card with the license of the downloaded extension. Takes the license identifier from Open VSX, such as MIT, or the words for a license that is not stated.
Takes the place of the license identifier in the theme download card and in the notice when Open VSX names no license for the extension.
Marker after a theme name in the theme download list: the theme is made for a dark background.
Marker after a theme name in the theme download list: the theme is made for a light background.
Notice in the status bar after a color theme was downloaded from Open VSX and applied. Takes the theme name and the license identifier, or the words for a license that is not stated.
strings.en: Color theme "{label}" installed from Open VSX (license: {license}).

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the typed text is neither an extension ID (publisher.name) nor a link to the extension on the VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX. Nothing was downloaded.
strings.en: Not a valid extension ID or link.
strings.de: Keine gültige Erweiterungs-ID und kein gültiger Link.

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when Open VSX has no extension with the typed ID. Takes the ID.
Error in the theme download card when Open VSX answers with an unexpected HTTP status. Takes the status number.
Error in the theme download card when no connection to Open VSX could be made, for example without internet or when the name cannot be resolved. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
Error in the theme download card when Open VSX does not answer within the time limit.
strings.en: Open VSX did not answer in time
strings.de: Open VSX hat nicht rechtzeitig geantwortet

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the encrypted connection to Open VSX fails, for example because of a certificate problem. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: The secure connection to Open VSX failed ({detail})
strings.de: Die sichere Verbindung zu Open VSX ist fehlgeschlagen ({detail})

strings.context: Error in the theme download card for any other network failure while talking to Open VSX. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
Error in the theme download card when the answer of Open VSX about the extension cannot be read. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: Open VSX sent an answer that cannot be read ({detail})
strings.de: Open VSX hat eine Antwort geschickt, die sich nicht lesen lässt ({detail})

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the answer of Open VSX holds no download link for the extension.
strings.en: Open VSX gave no download link for this extension
strings.de: Open VSX hat für diese Erweiterung keinen Download-Link angegeben

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the download would leave Open VSX, which ncrs refuses. Takes the host name the link pointed to.
strings.en: Download refused: {host} is not Open VSX
strings.de: Download abgelehnt: {host} ist nicht Open VSX

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when Open VSX forwards the download more than three times.
strings.en: Open VSX forwarded the download too often
strings.de: Open VSX hat den Download zu oft weitergeleitet

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the extension package is bigger than the limit of 20 MB.
strings.en: The extension is larger than 20 MB
strings.de: Die Erweiterung ist größer als 20 MB

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the downloaded file is not a usable extension package (a VSIX, which is a ZIP archive). Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: The download is not a usable extension package ({detail})
strings.de: Der Download ist kein brauchbares Erweiterungspaket ({detail})

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the downloaded extension contributes no color theme.
strings.en: This extension contains no color theme

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when a file the extension names for its theme is not in the package. Takes the file path as the extension spells it.
strings.en: The theme file {path} is missing in the extension
strings.de: Die Themendatei {path} fehlt in der Erweiterung

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the extension names a file path that leads out of its own folder or is otherwise unsafe. Nothing was written. Takes the path as the extension spells it.
strings.en: The extension names an unsafe file path: {path}
strings.de: Die Erweiterung nennt einen unsicheren Dateipfad: {path}

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when a file inside the extension package is bigger than its limit. Takes the file path inside the package.
strings.en: {path} in the extension is too large
strings.de: {path} in der Erweiterung ist zu groß

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when a theme or manifest file inside the extension is not valid JSON. Takes the file path and the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
strings.en: {path} in the extension is not valid JSON ({detail})
strings.de: {path} in der Erweiterung ist kein gültiges JSON ({detail})

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the system names no place for the config file, so the theme cannot be switched on.
strings.en: The system names no place for the config file, so the theme cannot be installed.
strings.de: Das System nennt keinen Ort für die Konfigurationsdatei, daher kann das Farbschema nicht installiert werden.

strings.context: Error in the theme download card when the theme files or the config file could not be written. Takes the path and the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action download_ocr_models, which opens the card asking whether to download the models for reading scanned pages. The name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a card with a question follows.
Title of the card that asks before the models for text recognition (OCR) of scanned pages are downloaded.

Explanation at the top of the card for the download of the OCR models. Scanned pages have no text of their own; the models read it from the picture. They are not part of ncrs and are downloaded once, only after the user presses the download button.
strings.en: Scanned pages are read with the text recognition of the ocrs project. It needs two model files that are not part of ncrs. Nothing is sent until you press Download. Each file is checked against its size and checksum before it is used. Where the system has its own text recognition (macOS), that one is used first and these models are only the fallback.
strings.de: Gescannte Seiten werden mit der Texterkennung des ocrs-Projekts gelesen. Dafür braucht es zwei Modelldateien, die nicht zu ncrs gehören. Es wird nichts gesendet, bevor du auf Laden drückst. Jede Datei wird vor der Nutzung gegen Größe und Prüfsumme geprüft. Wo das System eine eigene Texterkennung hat (macOS), wird zuerst diese genutzt und diese Modelle sind nur der Ersatz.

strings.context: Line in the OCR models card naming the server the files are downloaded from. Takes the host name.
Line in the OCR models card naming one model file and its size. Takes the file name and the size with its unit, for example 2.4 MB.
Line in the OCR models card under a model file: its SHA-256 checksum, which the download must match. Takes the checksum as 64 hexadecimal characters.
Line in the OCR models card naming the folder the files are saved in. Takes the folder path.
Line in the OCR models card saying whose models these are. Takes the address of the project page, shown as plain text.
strings.en: The models are made by the ocrs project: {project}

strings.context: Button in the OCR models card that starts the download. Verb.
Line in the OCR models card while the files are being downloaded.
Notice in the status bar after the OCR models were downloaded and checked.
strings.en: Text recognition models downloaded. Scanned pages are read from now on.
strings.de: Modelle für die Texterkennung geladen. Gescannte Seiten werden ab jetzt gelesen.

strings.context: Error in the OCR models card when the download failed or a file did not pass the check. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated. A file that failed is never put in place.
Error in the OCR models card when there is no data folder to save the models in.
strings.en: There is no data folder to save the models in.
strings.de: Es gibt keinen Datenordner, in dem die Modelle gespeichert werden könnten.

strings.context: Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action rule_suggestions, which opens the view with the rules Hermes suggests from how documents are already filed. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action rule_suggestions, shown dimmed after its plain name action.rule_suggestions in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (a requisition is a request to be approved); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Paragraph at the top of the rule suggestions view. Says where the suggestions come from and that none of them does anything before the user confirms it.
strings.en: Suggested from how your documents are already filed. A suggestion does nothing until you confirm it.
strings.de: Vorgeschlagen aus der bisherigen Ablage deiner Dokumente. Ein Vorschlag bewirkt nichts, bevor du ihn bestätigst.

strings.context: Line in the rule suggestions view while the document folders are being read and the suggestions are made. It runs in the background.
Line in the rule suggestions view when there is no suggestion. Suggestions need a document folder in which several documents share a phrase.
strings.en: No suggestions. They appear when several documents of a document folder share a phrase.
strings.de: Keine Vorschläge. Sie entstehen, wenn mehrere Dokumente eines Dokumentenordners eine Wendung teilen.

strings.context: Heading of the first column of the rule suggestions list: the text a document has to contain for the rule to apply.
Heading of the second column of the rule suggestions list: the filing pattern, which says where a matching document is filed.
Heading of the third column of the rule suggestions list: the kind of document the rule sets, such as Invoice.
Heading of the last column of the rule suggestions list: how many documents support the suggestion.

Heading above the list of documents in the rule suggestions view that the selected suggestion matches, so the user can check the evidence.

Label of the field in the edit form of a suggested rule: the kind of document the rule sets, such as Invoice.

strings.context: Error line in the edit form of a suggested rule when the kind field is empty.
strings.de: Gib die Art des Dokuments ein.

strings.de: Dieses Muster ist nicht verwendbar. Platzhalter stehen in geschweiften Klammern, etwa {year}.

strings.context: Error line in the rule suggestions view when reading or writing the rules failed. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated.
Button in the rule suggestions view: closes it.
Button in the rule suggestions view: reads the document folders again and refreshes the suggestions.
Button in the rule suggestions view: throws the selected suggestion away; it is not suggested again.
Button in the rule suggestions view: opens the form to change the text, kind or pattern of the selected suggestion before confirming it.
Button in the edit form of a suggested rule: closes the form without confirming and drops the changes.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action reorganisation_plan, which opens the view with the plan for tidying the document folders. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; the key bound to it is shown beside it.

Theme name of the key action reorganisation_plan, shown dimmed after its plain name action.reorganisation_plan in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (taking inventory before tidying up); the plain name beside it says what the action does.

Entry of the command list that runs the key action undo_reorganisation, which moves the documents of the last carried out reorganisation back. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry.
Theme name of the key action undo_reorganisation, shown dimmed after its plain name in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name; the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Status bar message after the reorganisation plan was carried out. Takes the number of moved and of skipped documents.
Status bar message after the last reorganisation was undone. Takes the number of documents moved back and of those left where they are.
strings.en: {moved} moved back, {skipped} left where they are

strings.context: Status bar message after inbox documents were filed by the rules. Takes the number of filed documents and of those that need a look because their place is taken or no rule places them now.
Status bar message when undo was asked for but no carried out reorganisation is left to undo.
Paragraph at the top of the reorganisation plan view. Says that the view only proposes changes to the document folders and that nothing is moved before the user runs the selected steps.
strings.en: A plan for tidying your document folders. Nothing is moved until you run the selected steps.
strings.de: Ein Plan zum Aufräumen deiner Dokumentenordner. Nichts wird verschoben, bevor du die ausgewählten Schritte ausführst.

strings.context: Line in the reorganisation plan view while the plan is being worked out in the background, before any entry can be shown.
Line in the reorganisation plan view when the plan has no entry: every document is already where the folder it is in expects it.
strings.en: Nothing to tidy up. Every document is where its folder expects it.
strings.de: Nichts aufzuräumen. Jedes Dokument liegt dort, wo sein Ordner es erwartet.

strings.context: Heading of the group of plan entries that are copies of a file kept elsewhere; the plan moves such a copy into a separate folder and never deletes it.
Heading of the group of plan entries whose text matches a rule that files documents in another folder than the one they are in.
Heading of the group of plan entries that lie in a folder of one year although the document is dated in another year.
Heading of the group of plan entries whose file name does not follow the naming pattern of the folder they are in.
Heading of the group of plan entries that cannot be carried out: the target is taken, or too little is known about the document. They are shown for information and cannot be selected.
Count behind a group heading of the reorganisation plan view: how many of the entries of the group are selected to be run.
Column heading in the reorganisation plan view above the current path of each document, below its document folder.
Column heading in the reorganisation plan view above the path each document would get, below its document folder.
Column heading in the reorganisation plan view above the plain-text reason for each proposal.
Reason of a plan entry that is a copy. Takes the path of the copy that stays where it is.
Reason of a plan entry that a confirmed rule files in another folder.
strings.de: Eine Regel legt es woanders ab

strings.context: Reason of a plan entry that a suggested rule files in another folder, where the user has not confirmed that rule yet; such an entry starts unselected.
strings.en: An unconfirmed rule files it elsewhere
strings.de: Eine unbestätigte Regel legt es woanders ab

strings.context: Reason of a plan entry that lies in the folder of the wrong year. Takes the year of the folder and the year of the document.
Reason of a plan entry whose name differs from the others in its folder. Takes the naming pattern of the folder.
strings.en: Does not follow the name pattern {pattern}

strings.context: Reason why a plan entry cannot be carried out: a file already exists at the path it would get.
Reason why a plan entry cannot be carried out: another entry of the same plan wants the same path.
strings.en: Another file wants the same target
strings.de: Eine andere Datei will dasselbe Ziel

strings.context: Reason why a plan entry cannot be carried out: the path it would get is not inside the document folder.
strings.en: The target would leave the folder
strings.de: Das Ziel läge außerhalb des Ordners

strings.context: Reason why a plan entry has no proposal: the fields the naming pattern of the folder needs, such as the date, are not known for the document.
strings.en: Not enough is known to name it
strings.de: Zu wenig bekannt für einen Namen

strings.context: Heading of the tree in the reorganisation plan view that shows the folders and files affected by the selected entries as they are now.
Heading of the tree in the reorganisation plan view that shows the folders and files affected by the selected entries as they would be after running them.
Line under a tree heading in the reorganisation plan view when no entry is selected, so there is nothing to show.
Line in the reorganisation plan view when the plan could not be worked out. Takes the technical detail, which stays English.
strings.en: The plan could not be made ({detail}).
strings.de: Der Plan konnte nicht erstellt werden ({detail}).

strings.context: Button in the reorganisation plan view: closes the view without running anything.
Button in the reorganisation plan view: works the plan out again from the documents as they are now, and drops the selection.
Button in the reorganisation plan view: hands the selected entries over to be carried out. Disabled while no entry is selected.
Last line under a tree of the reorganisation plan view when the tree has more lines than fit. Takes the number of lines left out.

Entry of the command palette that runs the key action download_ai_model, which opens the card asking whether to download the AI model that reads documents the rules could not read. The plain name of what the action does, as short as a menu entry; it has no key. The ellipsis says a card with a question follows.

Theme name of the key action download_ai_model, shown dimmed after its plain name action.download_ai_model in the command palette, and matched when typing. A playful name (in Futurama, heads are kept alive in jars); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Title of the card that asks before the AI model is downloaded.

Explanation at the top of the card for the download of the AI model. Some documents cannot be read by the rules alone; a small language model reads them. The model runs on this machine only and no document is sent anywhere. It is not part of ncrs and is downloaded only after the user presses the download button; an interrupted download continues where it stopped.
strings.en: Documents the rules cannot read are handed to a small AI model. It runs on this machine only; no document leaves it. The model is one file that is not part of ncrs. Nothing is sent until you press the button. An interrupted download continues where it stopped, and the file is checked against its size and checksum before it is used.
strings.de: Dokumente, die die Regeln nicht lesen können, übernimmt ein kleines KI-Modell. Es läuft nur auf diesem Rechner; kein Dokument verlässt ihn. Das Modell ist eine einzelne Datei, die nicht zu ncrs gehört. Es wird nichts gesendet, bevor du auf die Schaltfläche drückst. Ein unterbrochener Download wird dort fortgesetzt, wo er aufgehört hat, und die Datei wird vor der Nutzung gegen Größe und Prüfsumme geprüft.

strings.context: Line in the AI model card naming the server the file is downloaded from. Takes the host name.
Line in the AI model card naming the model file and its size. Takes the file name and the size with its unit, for example 639 MB.
Line in the AI model card under the model file: its SHA-256 checksum, which the download must match. Takes the checksum as 64 hexadecimal characters.
Line in the AI model card naming the license of the model. Takes the license name, which is not translated.
Line in the AI model card saying whose model this is. Takes the address of the model page, shown as plain text.
strings.en: The model is Qwen3 0.6B by the Qwen team: {project}
strings.de: Das Modell ist Qwen3 0.6B des Qwen-Teams: {project}

strings.context: Line in the AI model card naming the folder the file is saved in. Takes the folder path.
Button in the AI model card that starts the download. Verb.
Button in the AI model card that starts the download again after it was stopped or broke off. The file continues where it stopped. Verb.
Button in the AI model card that stops the running download. What was downloaded so far is kept. Verb.
Line in the AI model card while the file is being downloaded.
Line in the AI model card after Stop was pressed, until the download has noticed.
Line in the AI model card after the user stopped the download. Not an error: the part that was downloaded is kept.
strings.en: Paused. The download continues where it stopped.
strings.de: Angehalten. Der Download wird dort fortgesetzt, wo er aufgehört hat.

strings.context: Notice in the status bar after the AI model was downloaded and checked.
strings.en: AI model downloaded. Documents the rules cannot read are passed to it from now on.
strings.de: KI-Modell geladen. Dokumente, die die Regeln nicht lesen können, werden ab jetzt an es übergeben.

strings.context: Error in the AI model card when the download failed or the file did not pass the check. Takes the technical detail, which stays untranslated. A file that failed the check is never put in place.
Error in the AI model card when there is no data folder to save the model in.
strings.en: There is no data folder to save the model in.
strings.de: Es gibt keinen Datenordner, in dem das Modell gespeichert werden könnte.

strings.context: Label for the row on the filing status page that tells which AI model reads the documents the rules cannot read. The row is only there when the AI is switched on in the config.
Value of the AI model row on the filing status page when the AI is switched on but its model file has not been downloaded. Lower case.
Value of the AI model row on the filing status page when the model file is there but has not been needed yet, so it is not in memory. Lower case.
Value of the AI model row on the filing status page when the model is in memory. Takes the file name and the memory it uses with its unit, for example 700 MB.
Value of the AI model row on the filing status page when the model file could not be used. Takes the reason, which is English and stays untranslated.
Value of the AI model row on the filing status page when a server is asked instead of a model on this machine. Takes the address of the server (scheme and host) and the name of the model.

Line at the top of the review list explaining what the list holds.

Button in the review list: closes it.
Button in the review list after filing: creates a rule for the sender. Takes the sender.
Button in the review list: files the document with the fields shown.
Footer note in the review list after filing. Takes the path.

Entry of the command list and the menu that runs the key action saved_queries, which opens the page with the saved queries: searches over the index by year, tax context, kind, tags and text, with an export of what they find. Also the title of that Hermes page and its sidebar entry.

Theme name of the key action saved_queries, shown dimmed after its plain name action.saved_queries in the command list, and matched when typing. A playful name (an inquiry, filed like a form); the plain name beside it says what the action does.
Line at the top of the saved queries page explaining what it is for.
strings.en: Searches over your documents. Running one only looks; exporting copies the files it found into a folder you choose and never changes the originals.
strings.de: Suchen über deine Dokumente. Ausführen schaut nur nach; Exportieren kopiert die gefundenen Dateien in einen Ordner deiner Wahl und ändert die Originale nie.

strings.context: Shown on the saved queries page while the list loads.
Shown on the saved queries page when no query is saved yet.
strings.en: No saved queries yet. Fill in the form and save one.
strings.de: Noch keine Abfragen gespeichert. Fülle das Formular aus und speichere eine.

strings.context: Column header of the saved queries list: what the query asks for, in short.
Column header of the saved queries list: how many documents the query found the last time it ran here.
Short form of a query without any criterion in the saved queries list: it finds every document.
Form label on the saved queries page: the year of the document date.
Form label on the saved queries page: tax context.
Form label on the saved queries page: kind of document.
Form label on the saved queries page: tags.
Form label on the saved queries page: words that occur in the text of the document.

Description under the year field of the saved queries page.

strings.context: Description under the kind field of the saved queries page.
strings.en: Upper and lower case do not matter

strings.context: Description under the tags field of the saved queries page.

strings.context: Description under the full text field of the saved queries page.
strings.en: All words must occur in the text
strings.de: Alle Wörter müssen im Text vorkommen

strings.context: Problem on the saved queries page: the year text is not a year.

strings.context: Problem on the saved queries page: a query cannot be saved without a name.
strings.en: A saved query needs a name.
strings.de: Eine gespeicherte Abfrage braucht einen Namen.

strings.context: Problem on the saved queries page. Takes the error detail.
Button on the saved queries page: closes it.
Button on the saved queries page: starts an empty, new query.
Button on the saved queries page: saves the form as a query, or the change of the selected one.
Button on the saved queries page: asks whether to delete the selected query.
Button on the saved queries page: runs the query of the form and shows what it finds.
Button on the saved queries page: opens the step that asks where to export the found files. Disabled while there is nothing to copy.
Button on the saved queries page: backs out of the export step.
Question in the saved queries page before a query is deleted. Takes the name of the query.
strings.en: Delete the query ‘{name}’? Documents stay as they are.

strings.context: Button in the delete question of the saved queries page: deletes the query.
Label of a figure under a run of a saved query: how many documents were found.
Button under a run of a saved query: shows the found documents.
Button under a run of a saved query: hides the found documents.
Last line under the list of found documents when there are more than fit. Takes the number left out.
Mark behind a found document whose file is gone.
Heading of the export step on the saved queries page.

strings.de: Kopiert nur, verschiebt und löscht nichts. Vorhandene Dateien bleiben unangetastet.

Button in the export step: copies the files and writes the CSV.
